symptom: check --references refused `menu item 'Home' (OnClick: call microflow System.ShowHomePage)` — what describe navigation prints for the Home item of many starter apps — with 'microflow not found: System.ShowHomePage'.
cause: buildMicroflowQualifiedNames lists the project's stored microflows only; the System module ships with the platform and is never stored.
fix: meta.SystemMicroflows (measured: the System module's only microflow on 11.12.6 is ShowHomePage) is added to the listing — only when the listing is non-empty, since every caller reads an empty set as 'could not be read' and skips the check.
insight: Measure the System module instead of guessing: `mx dump-mpr --module-names=System --unit-type=...` on a blank project lists exactly what the platform ships (1 microflow, 0 nanoflows, 2 image collections). Adding synthetic names to a 'known' set must not make an unreadable listing look readable.
